summary: Fixes the Delete account button, which looked disabled while it was active, updates third-party libraries to close known vulnerabilities and is the first release cut with the new release pipeline. Nothing to do before upgrading.

changes.description: Delete account page: the Delete account button no longer looks disabled while it is active; it uses the red cancel style.
Third-party libraries of the web app and of the server are updated to close known vulnerabilities, including express, body-parser and handlebars on the server.
The server's process manager pm2, used by the start:prod script, moves from version 6 to 7, and express from 4.21 to 4.22. No configuration change.
The Helm chart is now apiVersion v2 and sets kubeVersion to >=1.24.0-0, in line with the Kubernetes range of the compatibility file; its version is set at release time.
Releases are now prepared from the release files in publication/, published after an approval and declared to the release managers; the old test environment deployment is removed.
